- Removed the file skill-card.md. 
- No changes to functionality or documentation beyond removal of this file.

Initial release of Packing Pro — generates smart, categorized packing lists tailored to your trip.

- Weather-adaptive recommendations based on season and destination.
- Duration- and activity-aware: adjusts clothing and adds specialized gear as needed.
- Considers transport type, with packing rule adaptations (e.g., flight liquid limits).
- Highlights critical items (e.g., passport, medications) with a dedicated section.
- Outputs a structured, weighted checklist for easy reference and baggage management.
- Includes CLI and interactive modes for flexible use.
